Not a live news-wire feed — update this file (or re-run research) to refresh. Built for Meesho 3P logistics capacity planning (Delhivery · Shadowfax · Xpressbees): LM/FM manifestation, non-adherence hotspots, and serviceability-loss tracking. Not an official Meesho product.

upcomingEvents.title: Independence Day (Aug 15): Delhi heavy-vehicle entry ban Aug 12-15 & intensified CISF/Metro security checks
Telangana gig & platform workers' indefinite strike (autos/cabs/Swiggy/Zomato/Zepto) may resume if govt assurances unmet

alerts.title: Kishtwar's Chatroo cloudburst and Kargil's Hardass-Tumail flash floods sweep away vehicles, cut roads
alerts.summary: A cloudburst hit Chatroo in Kishtwar district on Aug 1, washing away parked vehicles and cracking houses in the local market; separately, flash floods hit Hardass and Tumail villages in Kargil district on Aug 3, snapping road connectivity and damaging apricot orchards. J&K has logged 35 cloudbursts and 31 deaths this monsoon season, with Poonch, Rajouri, Kathua, Doda and Kishtwar the worst-hit belts.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk across Chenab Valley and Kargil: keep NS flags active for Kishtwar, Doda, Kargil talukas pending road restoration confirmation; build 2-3 day TAT buffer for any pincode routed via these valleys and monitor for repeat cloudbursts through mid-August.

alerts.title: Jammu-Srinagar NH44 reopened Aug 2 after 2-day closure; HMVs still regulated, weather-dependent
alerts.summary: The Jammu-Srinagar National Highway, closed twice in late July for landslide clearance and carriageway widening between Udhampur and Banihal, reopened for light vehicles on both directions on Aug 2. Heavy vehicles and load carriers are being regulated to move mainly Udhampur-to-Srinagar, subject to weather conditions.
alerts.impact: Watch list, not a current stoppage: Kashmir Valley-bound linehaul (Srinagar, Baramulla, Anantnag) can resume but expect intermittent HMV convoy restrictions — build 1-day contingency buffer and avoid committing tight SLAs on Valley pincodes until the corridor has a stable multi-day run.

alerts.title: Over 100 roads shut across Himachal; landslide near Bhariad (Chamba) buries a dozen vehicles, Kiratpur-Manali blocked
alerts.summary: A landslide near Bhariad village on the Udaipur-Golthi-Navodaya road in Chamba buried about a dozen vehicles and damaged 25+ houses; a separate landslide blocked the Kiratpur-Manali road. State-wide, 100+ roads remain closed with IMD warning of a moderate flash-flood threat in Chamba, Kangra, Kullu, Mandi, Shimla, Sirmaur and Solan through mid-August.
alerts.impact: Non-adherence hotspot: Kullu-Manali and Chamba corridors are high risk for LM delays — pre-position buffer stock at Mandi/Shimla hubs, flag Chamba-district pincodes NS until PWD confirms clearance, and hold alternate-route options via Kiratpur ready for Manali-bound dispatches.

alerts.title: Rajasthan transporters begin indefinite strike over VLTD costs & permits; 10,000+ trucks off the road
alerts.summary: Transporters' associations across Rajasthan launched an indefinite strike from Sunday midnight (Aug 9) over Vehicle Location Tracking Device (VLTD) costs — cited at ₹25,000-30,000 in Rajasthan versus ₹5,000-6,000 elsewhere — plus permit renewal and e-detection challan issues. Over 10,000 trucks have been grounded statewide.
alerts.impact: Direct FM/LM stoppage risk: Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur and Kota hub linehaul into and out of Rajasthan is exposed — activate alternate 3P carriers for inbound/outbound freight, pre-build 3-5 day buffer stock, and prepare SLA-relaxation comms for Rajasthan pincodes until the strike is resolved.

alerts.title: Delhi bans heavy-vehicle entry Aug 12-13 & Aug 14-15 ahead of Independence Day; Metro security checks intensified from Aug 9
alerts.summary: Delhi Traffic Police will restrict heavy vehicle entry into the capital from 8 PM Aug 12 to 1 PM Aug 13, and again from 8 PM Aug 14 to 1 PM Aug 15; Sonepat Police has separately banned heavy vehicles entering Delhi from Haryana ahead of the Independence Day rehearsals and main event. CISF has intensified security checks at Delhi Metro stations from Aug 9 through Aug 16.
alerts.impact: Plan FM linehaul into Delhi NCR hubs around the two ban windows (Aug 12 8PM-13 1PM and Aug 14 8PM-15 1PM) — pre-dispatch heavy loads before the cutoffs or hold until each window lifts; expect minor last-mile delays near central Delhi on Aug 15 morning due to road closures for the parade route.

alerts.title: Konkan coast on flash-flood watch: moderate-to-high risk flagged for Raigad, Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg
alerts.summary: IMD has flagged a moderate-to-high risk of flash floods over the next 24-48 hours across Konkan and Goa, with light-to-moderate rain and 30-40 kmph winds forecast for Palghar, Thane, Mumbai, Raigad, Ratnagiri and Sindhudurg. These districts' Western Ghats terrain makes them recurrently prone to landslides and flooding through August.
alerts.impact: Watch list for Mumbai-Goa NH66 corridor: keep alternate routing options ready for Raigad/Ratnagiri/Sindhudurg pincodes and build extra transit buffer for Konkan-bound LM dispatches through mid-August; no confirmed road closure yet, so hold off on blanket NS flags.

alerts.title: Nadukani-Parappanangadi highway landslide in Malappuram cuts off traffic; state-wide Kerala floods kill 15
alerts.summary: Multiple landslides on Aug 3 tore through the Nadukani-Parappanangadi State Highway between Edeypalam and Karathodu in Malappuram district, sending soil, trees and rocks onto the road and into the Kadalundi River; traffic is being diverted via Konompara. Statewide, heavy rain and landslides have killed 15 people across Kerala, with 11,018 people sheltering in 316 relief camps.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Malappuram belt: flag Vengara-route pincodes NS until the Nadukani-Parappanangadi stretch clears, use the Konompara diversion for LM continuity, and pre-position buffer stock at Kozhikode/Malappuram hubs given the elevated relief-camp load on local infrastructure.

alerts.title: Netravati & Kumaradhara rivers swell near danger mark in Dakshina Kannada; Bantwal, Uppinangady inundated
alerts.summary: The Netravati river is flowing near its danger mark (8.4m against 8.5m) near Uppinangady, while rising water in low-lying Bantwal has forced evacuations; the Kumaradhara river also swelled, flooding parts of the district. An orange alert is in force for Dakshina Kannada, Shivamogga and Chikkamagaluru through Aug 13, and schools were shut on Aug 1 due to rain intensity.
alerts.impact: Watch/partial NS for Bantwal and Uppinangady pincodes near Mangaluru hub: hold non-serviceable flags for low-lying zones until river levels recede below danger mark, and build extra transit time for Mangaluru-bound LM dispatches through the orange-alert window.

alerts.title: Heavy rain floods Hyderabad roads; 454 damage spots across 629 km of Telangana/AP road network
alerts.summary: A low-pressure area near the Jharkhand-West Bengal border triggered widespread rain and waterlogging across Telangana, with an Orange Alert for north Telangana; officials report damage at 454 spots covering 629 km of the road network, with several village-to-village rivulet crossings on spate.
alerts.impact: Watch list for Hyderabad hub and rural Telangana/AP pincodes: pre-flag village link roads on spate as at-risk, expect intra-district LM delays where rivulet crossings are cut, and monitor for road-damage-driven non-adherence in the worst-hit 454 spots.

alerts.title: Telangana gig & platform workers defer indefinite strike by 10 days after govt assurance on fares, welfare board
alerts.summary: The Telangana Gig and Platform Workers Union and Telangana App-Based Drivers Forum postponed a planned indefinite strike — which would have hit autos, cabs, Ola, Uber, Rapido, Swiggy, Zomato, Zepto and Instamart — for 10 days after Labour Minister Gaddam Vivek Venkataswamy's government sought time to act on fair fares, the Welfare Board and Motor Vehicle Aggregator Guidelines.
alerts.impact: Contingency planning for ~Aug 18: this directly threatens app-based LM/delivery capacity in Hyderabad if talks fail. Track government action on the 10-day window and pre-identify backup LM partners for Hyderabad pincodes in case the strike resumes.

alerts.title: Assam floods kill 98, affect 155,000+ across 13 districts; Sivasagar, Charaideo, Jorhat, Golaghat worst-hit
alerts.summary: The death toll from Assam's 2026 floods has risen to 98, with over 155,000 people affected across 13 districts. Cloudbursts upstream drove sudden surges in tributaries like the Dikhow and Dhansiri that arrived ahead of the Brahmaputra's own peak, pushing water into areas — Sivasagar, Charaideo, Jorhat and Golaghat — that rarely flood. More than 2,000 villages and 10,748 hectares of cropland remain submerged.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss — widespread: maintain NS flags across the 13 affected districts, especially Sivasagar/Charaideo/Jorhat/Golaghat where flooding is unusual and local infra is least prepared; expect extended TAT breaches on Guwahati hub linehaul and coordinate contingency capacity with all three 3P partners for NE routing.

alerts.title: Brahmaputra erosion threatens Borakhat (Kamrup), Doulashal & Roumari Pathar (Nalbari) villages
alerts.summary: Workers are stacking geo bags along the Brahmaputra at Borakhat village in Kamrup district to arrest riverbank erosion. In Nalbari district, residents of Doulashal in Barkhetri and nearby Roumari Pathar have faced nearly a month of continuous erosion, raising fear of land loss for several adjoining villages.
alerts.impact: Early-warning watch for Kamrup/Nalbari rural pincodes: no LM stoppage yet, but monitor for sudden road-loss if erosion accelerates near Borakhat/Doulashal — flag as a leading indicator for future non-serviceable zones rather than an immediate action item.

alerts.title: Landslide severs Ngari village (Ukhrul) from district; floods isolate border villages in Senapati, Kamjong
alerts.summary: Two days of incessant rain triggered flash floods and landslides across Manipur's Senapati, Ukhrul and Kamjong hill districts. A rain-triggered landslide destroyed nearly 100 metres of road, completely cutting off Ngari village from the rest of Ukhrul district; residents are crossing swollen streams on foot to reach farms and services. Major rivers rose above danger level, inundating farmland and fish ponds near residential settlements.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss — Ukhrul/Senapati/Kamjong border villages: flag Ngari and adjoining cut-off villages NS until the road is restored; this is a hyperlocal, single-road failure rather than a district-wide closure, so surrounding Ukhrul pincodes may still be reachable via alternate approach roads.

alerts.title: Nagaland restoration progresses: Phek/Noklak roads cleared, but NH-702A Satakha-Kilomi stretch still narrow, weeks from full repair
alerts.summary: Road connectivity has been restored in parts of Phek and Noklak districts after PWD cleared a major landslide near Tsundang village, but restoration continues in Kohima, Tuensang, Longleng and Peren. A narrow, cautious-passage section has reopened on NH-702A between Satakha and Kilomi village, though full restoration may take over a week.
alerts.impact: Downgraded from critical to a partial-capacity watch: LM can resume cautiously via Tsundang/Phek/Noklak, but keep single-lane-convoy delays priced into SLAs for the Satakha-Kilomi stretch and continue NS flags for any pincode solely dependent on that section until full clearance.

alerts.title: IMD red alert for Meghalaya, Sikkim & Sub-Himalayan West Bengal; slopes destabilising in Meghalaya, Mizoram
alerts.summary: IMD has issued red alerts for Meghalaya, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim for extremely heavy rainfall, with orange alerts for Arunachal Pradesh, Bihar, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura. Heavy rain has already destabilised slopes and triggered landslides in parts of Meghalaya and Mizoram.
alerts.impact: Region-wide watch for Shillong/Aizawl-linked hubs: no specific village-level closure confirmed yet, but pre-position buffer stock and keep alternate NE routing on standby given the red-alert severity — escalate to NS flags if any specific ghat-road closure is confirmed.

alerts.title: Low-pressure area over Bay of Bengal triggers fisherman warning off Odisha, West Bengal coasts; orange alert for 4 Odisha districts
alerts.summary: A low-pressure area over the north Bay of Bengal/coastal Gangetic West Bengal has triggered squally winds of 35-45 kmph (gusting to 55 kmph) and a fisherman advisory to stay ashore along the West Bengal and Odisha coasts. An orange warning is in force for four Odisha districts, with 7-20 cm rainfall expected over parts of South Bengal.
alerts.impact: Port and coastal-hub watch: Paradip/Kolkata-linked coastal linehaul and fishing-village pincodes should hold buffer for delayed FM pickup; no landfall/cyclone confirmed — treat as a cost/route watch rather than an active stoppage.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel hold at multi-city highs; commercial LPG cylinder cut ₹194 in August, domestic LPG unchanged
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged in early August, holding at elevated levels — Delhi ₹102.12/₹95-98 (petrol/diesel), Mumbai ₹111.21, Bengaluru ₹111.68, Hyderabad ₹115.43. Domestic LPG is flat month-on-month, while the Commercial LPG (19kg) cylinder price has dropped by ₹194 in August (e.g. to ₹2,691.50 in Mumbai from ₹2,885.50).
alerts.impact: Cost watch, no LM/FM action needed yet: sustained high retail fuel keeps pressure on 3P per-km rates, but the commercial LPG cut is a mild tailwind for hub operating costs. Track weekly for early signal on Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees fuel surcharge asks ahead of the next OMC pricing cycle.
